sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO T_PLAYER_TREASURE(PLAYER_ID, TREASURE_ID, NUM) VALUES(#playerID#, #treasureID#, #num#)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE T_PLAYER_TREASURE SET NUM=#num# WHERE PLAYER_ID=#playerID# AND TREASURE_ID=#treasureID#
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM T_PLAYER_TREASURE WHERE PLAYER_ID=#playerID# AND TREASURE_ID=#treasureID#
sqlMap.select: SELECT PLAYER_ID AS playerID, TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NUM AS num FROM T_PLAYER_TREASURE WHERE PLAYER_ID=#playerID# AND TREASURE_ID=#treasureID#
SELECT PLAYER_ID AS playerID, TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NUM AS num FROM T_PLAYER_TREASURE
SELECT PLAYER_ID AS playerID, TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NUM AS num FROM T_PLAYER_TREASURE WHERE PLAYER_ID=#playerID#

SELECT PLAYER_ID AS playerID, A.TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NUM AS num FROM T_PLAYER_TREASURE A INNER JOIN T_TREASURE B ON (A.TREASURE_ID=B.TREASURE_ID) WHERE PLAYER_ID=#playerID# AND CATEGORY=#category# ORDER BY A.TREASURE_ID

SELECT PLAYER_ID AS playerID, A.TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NUM AS num FROM T_PLAYER_TREASURE A INNER JOIN T_TREASURE B ON (A.TREASURE_ID=B.TREASURE_ID) WHERE PLAYER_ID=#playerID# AND CATEGORY=#category# AND TYPE=#type# ORDER BY A.TREASURE_ID

SELECT A.TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NAME AS name, DESCRIPTION AS description, CATEGORY AS category, TYPE AS type, COST AS cost, IMGSRC AS imgSrc, IFNULL(NUM,0) AS num, CAN_BUY AS canBuy, DIRECT_USE_TOOLTIP AS directUseTooltip FROM T_PLAYER_TREASURE A INNER JOIN T_TREASURE B ON (A.TREASURE_ID=B.TREASURE_ID) WHERE PLAYER_ID=#playerID# AND CATEGORY=#category# ORDER BY A.TREASURE_ID

SELECT A.TREASURE_ID AS treasureID, NAME AS name, DESCRIPTION AS description, CATEGORY AS category, TYPE AS type, COST AS cost, IMGSRC AS imgSrc, IFNULL(NUM,0) AS num, CAN_BUY AS canBuy, DIRECT_USE_TOOLTIP AS directUseTooltip FROM T_TREASURE A LEFT JOIN (SELECT TREASURE_ID,NUM FROM T_PLAYER_TREASURE WHERE PLAYER_ID=#playerID# ) B ON (A.TREASURE_ID=B.TREASURE_ID) WHERE CATEGORY=#category# AND TYPE=#type# ORDER BY A.TREASURE_ID
